module: Export of the Road Architect network in OpenDRIVE 1.8 format (.xodr). Each road (excluding overlays) is converted to OpenDRIVE geometry: reference line approximated by 2D parametric cubics (paramPoly3, Chordal Catmull-Rom tangents), elevation profile in explicit cubics, lane widths and heights per section. The file is written via the editor file selector (editor_fileDialog.saveFile). If no Road Architect road exists, the export falls back to tech_openDriveExporter to export the road network of the loaded map.
notes: Exported lane types: 'road_lane' -> driving, 'sidewalk' -> walking, any other type (islands, concrete...) -> restricted.
Roads without nodes are ignored; overlays (isOverlay) are not exported. Each road is written with rule="RHT", junction="-1" and an id equal to its rank - 1.

Predecessor/successor links (link tag of roads and lanes), objects, signals and surface are not exported: the tags are written empty or as comments (the code contains a TODO for the lane link). The header writes north/south/east/west as 0.0.
The center mark is always written as a standard broken line, whatever the profile's paint.
If the file cannot be opened for writing, io.open returns nil and the write fails (no check in the code).

export.desc: Exports the current Road Architect network to .xodr. Filters out empty roads, converts non-overlay roads to OpenDRIVE geometry, then opens a save dialog (.xodr extension, overwrite confirmation) and writes the file. With no roads, exports the map's road network instead via tech_openDriveExporter.
